q: Assemble a benchmark that actually measures.
explain: Benchmark prefix, loop exactly b.N times, work inside. No loop and you benchmarked an empty function at lightning speed.
Loop, test each value, act inside the branch. Structure nests like bowls: loop outside, condition inside, action innermost.
Open, bail on error, defer the close immediately, then work. Defer early so no path forgets.
Lock, defer unlock, mutate, return. The defer sits right under the lock so no future edit can strand it.
Test prefix, condition, Fatal on failure, braces balanced. Skip any piece and go test silently ignores you.
Register the route, then block serving forever. nil means the default mux you just registered on.
